attacks.name: Lowe's man-in-the-middle attack
attacks.summary: The attacker registers under its own identity, is legitimately chosen as A's peer, and relays the handshake to B; B completes believing its peer is A, and both nonces end up known to the attacker.
attacks.reference: G. Lowe, An attack on the Needham-Schroeder public-key authentication protocol, IPL, 1995
